scripts.typegen: sanity schema extract --force && sanity typegen generate
scripts.seed: sanity exec scripts/preflight.ts --with-user-token && sanity datasets import seed/production.ndjson --dataset production --missing
scripts.refresh: npx sanity@latest exec scripts/preflight.ts --with-user-token && npx sanity@latest datasets import seed/production.ndjson --dataset production --replace && npx sanity@latest exec scripts/clear-old-drafts.ts --with-user-token
